items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: I don't ever see them comparing Bach and Beethoven.

ctx.x: Well let me ask you this, to interject something along the lines. You're talking about those polls. One of the questions I asked you at the very beginning about jazz being an art form kind of music as opposed to the commercial kind of thing. The thing that has always bothered me about this poll business, I mean you're talking about a person, okay, you're an individual, I'm an individual. All the people you've named are individuals. I mean it seems to me when you start talking about an art form and artists, I…
Coleman Hawkins or vice versa. You know, that's what bothers me personally about the polls.
